correctness.rationale: For e-anchor a with kernel fiber P_a and f-image roots B, ef fixes its image e(B) iff f(a)∈P_a for each e-fiber meeting B. Partition rooted e-fibers into those without f-root, those whose anchor is an f-root, and those with an f-root away from the anchor, giving exponential block weights sz exp(sz), v x z exp((s+x)z), v x z² exp((s+x)z). Labeled set exponential formula yields claimed EGF. Extract u^r v^t x^s z^n via coefficients: s^(r-t) t^(s-t) z^(r+s-t)(1+z)^t exp(rs z)/[(r-t)!t!(s-t)!]. This recovers exact rank-triple formula including support n>=r+s-t and ordered composition convention. Independently brute-enumerated all idempotent maps on n=1..5 and every pair, computed actual products and rank triples, obtaining total qualifying ordered pairs [1,9,94,1417,28856] and exact agreement for every triple. Finite checks corroborate the reversible all-n labeled-block proof.
residual_risks: Finite independent enumerations/numerical examples only corroborate explicitly identified analytic or exhaustive-finite arguments; they do not prove unbounded statements.

value.rationale: The three-rank spectrum is a natural structural invariant of ordered idempotent pairs with one-sided composition idempotence in the full transformation monoid. Complete coefficient distribution for all n separates genuinely noncommuting arrangements and determines which rank triples occur. This is an exact natural finite-algebra census of unbounded size, useful without a downstream general theorem.

final_claim: For ordered total idempotents e,f on n labeled points with ef=e∘f also idempotent and ranks r,s,t, N_n(r,s,t)=n!s^(r-t)t^(s-t)/[t!(r-t)!(s-t)!] times sum_{j=0}^{min(t,L)} binom(t,j)(rs)^(L-j)/(L-j)!, L=n-r-s+t, on 1<=t<=min(r,s), L>=0; otherwise zero. Equivalent rooted-block EGF has exponent u(sz exp(sz)+v x z(1+z)exp((s+x)z)).
